versions.content: ECU State Manager (EcuM) The EcuM manages the state machine of the ECU lifecycle, including off-state, startup phases, run state, sleep modes, and shutdown sequences. function EcuM_Init [SWS_CP_SYS_00002] void EcuM_Init(void); Initializes the ECU State Manager during STARTUP Phase I before the OS is started. Sets up low-level drivers and prepares memory hardware. function EcuM_StartupTwo [SWS_CP_SYS_00003] void EcuM_StartupTwo(void); Carries out STARTUP Phase II activities after the OS has been started and the first BSW tasks are active. Starts the BswM and initializes higher-layer services. function EcuM_RequestRUN [SWS_CP_SYS_00006] Std_ReturnType EcuM_RequestRUN(EcuM_UserType user); Places a RUN state request on behalf of a SW-C or system component to prevent the ECU from transitioning into sleep or shutdown. function EcuM_ReleaseRUN [SWS_CP_SYS_00007] Std_ReturnType EcuM_ReleaseRUN(EcuM_UserType user); Releases a previously requested RUN state. When all RUN requests are released, EcuM permits transition to POST_RUN and shutdown. function EcuM_GoDown [SWS_CP_SYS_00004] Std_ReturnType EcuM_GoDown(uint16 callerHash); Instructs the EcuM to prepare shutdown and invoke shutdown hooks across all BSW modules. function EcuM_GoHalt [SWS_CP_SYS_00005] Std_ReturnType EcuM_GoHalt(void); Places the microcontroller into low-power sleep mode (HALT) awaiting hardware interrupt wakeup events. BSW Mode Manager (BswM) The BswM controls mode arbitration and executes configured action lists based on logical rule evaluations. function BswM_RequestMode [SWS_CP_SYS_00001] void BswM_RequestMode(BswM_UserType requesting_user, BswM_ModeType requested_mode); Service to request a BSW or application mode. Evaluates arbitration rules and triggers corresponding action lists. function BswM_Init [SWS_CP_SYS_00010] void BswM_Init(const BswM_ConfigType* ConfigPtr); Initializes the mode arbitration tables, state rules, and action list dispatchers. function BswM_MainFunction [SWS_CP_SYS_00011] void BswM_MainFunction(void); Periodic scheduled task for deferred mode rule evaluation and cyclic state processing. Watchdog Manager (WdgM) The WdgM supervises the correct execution of safety-critical software entities via Alive, Deadline, and Logical supervision mechanisms. function WdgM_Init [SWS_CP_SYS_00020] void WdgM_Init(const WdgM_ConfigType* ConfigPtr); Initializes the Watchdog Manager and configures supervision parameters for all registered supervised entities. function WdgM_CheckpointReached [SWS_CP_SYS_00021] Std_ReturnType WdgM_CheckpointReached(WdgM_SupervisedEntityIdType SEID, WdgM_CheckpointIdType CPID); Notifies the WdgM that a supervised execution checkpoint has been reached, updating Alive counters, Deadline timers, and Logical execution graph transitions. function WdgM_SetMode [SWS_CP_SYS_00022] Std_ReturnType WdgM_SetMode(WdgM_ModeType Mode); Switches watchdog supervision modes (e.g. SLOW_SUPERVISION, FAST_SUPERVISION, STOPPED_SUPERVISION) depending on vehicle operating states. function WdgM_MainFunction [SWS_CP_SYS_00023] void WdgM_MainFunction(void); Cyclically calculates global supervision status and triggers the Watchdog Interface (WdgIf) / Watchdog Driver if conditions are satisfied.
